meta.title: 大脸女生 八字刘海
meta.title_en: Face-Framing Curtain Bangs for Round Faces

scenes.context: 先从找到露白（发量少透头皮）的地方开始，往这边抠一点出来，确定修剪的起点。
sentences: 从这里抠一点头发出来。
Pull a little hair out from here.
paraphrase: Pull a little hair out from here.
scenes.speak: First find the thin spot. Pull a little hair out from here.

scenes.context: 把前面抠下来的头发再往前梳，就能盖住露白的地方，露出度立刻改善。
sentences: Comb it forward to cover the spot.
The thin spot disappears right away.
paraphrase: Comb it forward to cover the spot.
The thin spot disappears right away.
scenes.speak: Comb it forward to cover the spot. The thin spot disappears right away.

scenes.context: 把露白处的延长线修下来，再往上一点、再抠一点，控制层次与过渡。
sentences: Trim along the extension of the hairline.
Go a bit higher to adjust the layers.
paraphrase: Trim along the extension of the hairline.
Go a bit higher to adjust the layers.
scenes.speak: Trim along the extension of the hairline. Go a bit higher to adjust the layers.

scenes.context: 刮的时候刀不要压头皮，让刀刃立起来往前划，这样才不会损伤发根。
sentences: Keep the blade upright and glide forward.
Don't press the scissors against the scalp.
paraphrase: Keep the blade upright and glide forward.
Don't press the scissors against the scalp.
scenes.speak: Keep the blade upright and glide forward. Don't press the scissors against the scalp.

scenes.context: 刮完之后这一块多余的肉感就消失了，额角变柔和，脸型立刻有变化。
scenes.speak: The heaviness disappears. The temple area looks softer.

scenes.context: 把这一束头发拉到鼻子那里定位长度，八字刘海的发束要在鼻翼附近最修饰脸型。
sentences: Pull the section down to the nose to set length.
这一束在鼻翼附近最好看。
This piece frames best around the nose.
paraphrase: 用set the length换一种说法
Pull the section down to the nose to set length.
This piece frames best around the nose.
scenes.speak: Pull the section down to the nose to set length. This piece frames best around the nose.

scenes.context: 把后面都散开，中分后翻一个三角往前梳，分出左右两侧的修饰发束。
sentences: Part in the middle and section a triangle.
paraphrase: Part in the middle and section a triangle.
scenes.speak: Part in the middle and section a triangle. Sweep the sections forward.

scenes.context: 低点头、微微往后扳一点，把脸颊两侧的发量收进来，大脸立刻显小。
sentences: A slight tilt makes the face look smaller.
Sweep the hair toward the cheeks.
paraphrase: A slight tilt makes the face look smaller.
Sweep the hair toward the cheeks.
scenes.speak: A slight tilt makes the face look smaller. Sweep the hair toward the cheeks.

practice: 先找到头发露白的地方。
把发束往前梳盖住露白。
Comb it forward to cover the spot.
Keep the blade upright and glide forward.
把发束拉到鼻子定位长度。
Pull the section down to the nose to set length.
pitfalls: 先找露白处、抠出前发盖住
鼻翼附近的长度最修饰脸型
分区决定刘海整体走向
